title: Combining tests with AND and OR in customers

steps.title: Two tests joined by AND
steps.prompt: AND means BOTH tests must be true for a row to stay.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Fatima Fassi' AND id = 5;

Join with AND id = …
Write: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Fatima Fassi' AND id = 5;
